name: application-tag-input
title: Tag Input
description: Token/chip entry field supporting add-on-enter, backspace-to-remove, and an autocomplete suggestions variant for labels, recipients, and filters.
useWhen: Collecting an open-ended list of short values, such as labels, keywords, or email recipients.
The list of valid values is large or unbounded but a fixed suggestion set can speed up common entries.
You need each entered value to be individually removable without retyping the rest.
avoidWhen: The choices are a small, fixed set — a multi-select or checkbox group is clearer than free text entry.
Only a single value is needed — use a plain text input or a combobox instead.
responsiveBehavior: The tag field wraps chips onto multiple lines as they accumulate (flex-wrap) rather than truncating or scrolling, so it stays usable at narrow widths.
accessibility: The trigger input carries a label via a real <label for> association, and aria-describedby points at the help text explaining the Enter/Backspace interaction.
Each tag's remove button has an aria-label naming the specific tag being removed, not just a generic 'Remove'.

The autocomplete variant marks the input role="combobox" with aria-expanded and aria-controls kept in sync with the suggestion listbox's visibility, and each suggestion uses role="option" inside a role="listbox".

variants.title: Basic
variants.description: Free-text tag input where Enter adds a chip and Backspace on an empty field removes the last one
accessibility: Help text below the field documents the Enter/Backspace interaction for users who can't discover it by keyboard alone.
